name: Rione Monti
notes: Climb the sloping lanes between hundreds of conical trulli, then cross to quieter Aia Piccola.
imageAlt: Photograph of Rione Monti in Alberobello, Puglia

name: Basilica di San Nicola
notes: A serene Romanesque landmark in Bari Vecchia, built above the crypt of Saint Nicholas.
imageAlt: Photograph of Basilica di San Nicola in Bari, Puglia

name: Castello Carlo V
notes: A compact sixteenth-century fortress anchoring one of the prettiest corners of the old harbor.
imageAlt: Photograph of Castello Carlo V in Monopoli, Puglia

name: Gallipoli Old Town
notes: Circle the island walls, browse narrow lanes and watch fishing boats return beneath the castle.
imageAlt: Photograph of Gallipoli Old Town in Gallipoli, Puglia

name: Otranto Cathedral
notes: Its vast twelfth-century floor mosaic is a strange, wonderful tree of life filled with creatures and legends.
imageAlt: Photograph of Otranto Cathedral in Otranto, Puglia

name: Castello Aragonese
notes: Walk the bastions for harbor views; the fortress inspired the title of the first Gothic novel.
imageAlt: Photograph of Castello Aragonese in Otranto, Puglia

name: Basilica di Santa Croce
notes: Lecce Baroque at its most exuberant: animals, flowers and fantastical faces carved in warm local stone.
imageAlt: Photograph of Basilica di Santa Croce in Lecce, Puglia

name: Piazza del Duomo
notes: An enclosed theatrical square that becomes especially atmospheric when the honey-colored façades glow after dusk.
imageAlt: Photograph of Piazza del Duomo in Lecce, Puglia
